My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I came across the Software Engineer opening at Baton and wanted to reach out to someone on the engineering team directly.

I recently completed my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT (May 2026). I ve built end-to-end ML pipelines — a multi-modal agentic system (STT → LLM intent classification → YOLO visual servoing → robotic action, 100% pick reliability), fine-tuned a document understanding transformer from 55% to 93% accuracy, and shipped a YOLOv8 model to production users (78% → 97.5%). Python and PyTorch are my primary tools.

If my background seems like a fit, I d be grateful if you d be open to a referral or just a quick chat about what the team is building.
